tools.name: find_matches
tools.description: Upcoming football matches in a city or a country between two dates, with the cheapest ticket price we hold. Accepts exactly one of city or country. Supports filters for budget, men's or women's football, senior, reserve or youth sides, and top competitions. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

city.description: A city, for example Lisbon. Omit when naming a country.

country.description: A country, for example Portugal. Omit when naming a city.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Today unless given.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, any date ahead. 7 days after the first unless given, and at most 31 days after it.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 20 unless given, at most 50.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.

maxPrice.description: Keep only matches whose cheapest ticket costs at most this. The budget is compared with every ticket at today's exchange rate; a match priced only in a currency with no rate is kept and marked priceNotConverted, and a match with no price is left out.

amount.description: The most the visitor will pay for one ticket.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of that amount, for example EUR or GBP.

gender.description: men or women: who plays. Leaves out competitions classified the other way.

squad.description: senior, reserve or youth: which side plays. Leaves out competitions classified otherwise.

topRanksOnly.description: True to keep only the matches of the highest-ranked competitions found, for example the top division rather than the lower leagues. Friendlies are left out.

tools.name: find_matches_near
tools.description: Upcoming football matches within a distance of a point, given as latitude and longitude, between two dates, with the cheapest ticket price we hold. Supports locations outside named cities and the same budget, men's or women's, squad and top-competitions filters as find_matches. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point to search around, for example 38.72.

longitude.description: Longitude of the point to search around, for example -9.14.

radiusKm.description: How far from the point to look, in kilometres: 50 unless given, at most 200.

tools.name: match_details
tools.description: One match: kickoff, teams, competition, the cheapest price we hold at each ticket seller, the venue and any available travel directions. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.

team.description: The team's name, for example Benfica. A name not found may be known as written in its own country, for example Bayern München, with any suffix such as U19.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 20 unless given, at most 50.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.
